dndesires_ponder.ponder.smart_hopper.tex: The Smart Hopper is a Hopper with a filter
Only items that match its filter are moved
dndesires_ponder.ponder.fluid_gauge_and_: A Fluid Gauge on the side of a tank shows how much fluid is inside
A Fluid Hatch gives quick access to the tank: take fluid out or put fluid in by hand
dndesires_ponder.ponder.roll_table.text_: Items on a Roll Table roll across its top, like on an Item Drain. It needs no rotation
With nothing on the far side, items simply roll off the end
Otherwise they pass onto whatever is there: a belt, a depot, a funnel or another Roll Table
It can't turn items. They always leave on the side opposite where they came in
dndesires_ponder.ponder.dnd_casings.head: Industrial and Overburden Casing
dndesires_ponder.ponder.dnd_casings.text: Industrial Casing and Overburden Casing are decoration and crafting blocks
They connect like other casings, but can't be used to encase shafts or cogs
Industrial Casing is used to craft the Industrial Fan
dndesires_ponder.ponder.asphalt.text_1: Asphalt comes plain and in 16 colors
dndesires_ponder.ponder.asphalt.text_2: Walking on it is noticeably faster, and you jump higher. There's no potion effect involved
dndesires_ponder.ponder.asphalt.text_3: Plain Asphalt is made in a heated Mixer. Surround a dye with 8 Asphalt to color it
dndesires_ponder.ponder.bore_blocks.head: Bore Blocks
dndesires_ponder.ponder.bore_blocks.text: On a moving contraption, Bore Blocks break the blocks they're pushed into
They come plain and in 16 colors
dndesires_ponder.ponder.dnd_catalyst_sai: Catalyst Sails turn a fan's Air Flow into a processing setup without water, lava or fire
A Splashing Catalyst Sail washes items, just like water
A Smoking Catalyst Sail smokes food, just like fire
A Blasting Catalyst Sail smelts items, just like lava
A Haunting Catalyst Sail haunts items, just like soul fire
Air passes through sails, and unlike lava or fire they never flow or spread
They also count as Windmill Sails
Sanding, Freezing, Seething and Dragon Breathing Catalyst Sails work the same way
dndesires_ponder.ponder.dnd_fan_catalyst: Bulk Processing with Dreams n' Desires Catalysts
Air Flows passing through any Sand create a Sanding setup
Sanding wears items down, like scrubbing oxidation off copper
Powder Snow creates a Freezing setup
Freezing chills items, like turning Packed Ice into Blue Ice
A superheated Blaze Burner creates a Seething setup. A normal heat level won't
Seething runs hotter than Blasting, like turning Ender Pearls into Eyes of Ender
A Dragon Egg creates a Dragon Breathing setup
Dragon Breathing infuses items with the End, like filling bottles with Dragon's Breath
On an Industrial Fan, a Dragon Head on the fan's front face also works while powered by redstone
Each type also has a Catalyst Sail that works the same way as its block
Look up Bulk Sanding, Freezing, Seething and Dragon Breathing in JEI to see every recipe
The Hydraulic Press is a Mechanical Press that needs fluid to run
Pipe any liquid into either side without a shaft. Its tank holds 3000mB
Every press uses 1000mB, and it won't start with less than 1000mB in the tank. Gases don't work
Pressing a Basin does Hydraulic Compacting, which has its own recipes
It does not do normal Compacting recipes. Keep a Mechanical Press for those
Like a Mechanical Press, it also presses items on belts, depots and the ground
It presses at about a quarter of a Mechanical Press's speed at the same RPM
Look up Hydraulic Compacting in JEI to see every recipe
Generating Power with the Stirling Engine
The Stirling Engine attaches to the side of a furnace and turns its heat into rotation
Right-click the engine with a Flywheel and it snaps into place in front of it
Only one side of the Flywheel outputs rotation. Sneak while placing it to flip which side
A Cogwheel connects straight to the output side
So does a Shaft, to carry the power away
It only runs while the furnace is actually smelting something. Fuel alone isn't enough
Output depends on the furnace: a Furnace runs at 25%%, a Smoker at 50%% and a Blast Furnace at 75%%
dndesires_ponder.ponder.industrial_fan.t: The Industrial Fan is a stronger Encased Fan, driven through the cog on its side
It processes items twice as fast as an Encased Fan, and its air reaches up to 30 blocks
Every fan processing type works with it, including Dreams n' Desires' own
Facing down at a heat source while powered by redstone, it becomes a generator
It then outputs 64 RPM with 1024 SU. The direction can't be changed
Lava, a lit Blaze Burner or a Seething Catalyst Sail all count as heat
dndesires_ponder.ponder.industrial_fan_d: Right-click an Industrial Fan with any dye to color its blades
Use another dye to change the color at any time
dndesires_ponder.ponder.cog_cranks.text_: Cog Cranks are Hand Cranks shaped like cogwheels, for early power in tight spots
Turn one by hand and it drives the cogwheels it meshes with
A Cog Crank gives 32 RPM with 256 SU
A Large Cog Crank gives 16 RPM with 128 SU, half as much
dndesires_ponder.ponder.inverse_gearshif: The Inverse Gearshift always reverses rotation, with no redstone needed
Use it instead of a Gearshift that would only ever sit powered. It has no stress cost
dndesires_ponder.ponder.omni_gearbox.tex: The Omni Gearbox passes rotation to all six of its faces, including up and down
dndesires_ponder.ponder.omni_speed_contr: The Omni Speed Controller sets its output to any speed you choose, in a single block
Scroll on it to pick the speed, forward or reverse. It has no stress cost
dndesires_ponder.ponder.multimeter.text_: The Multimeter shows speed and stress together, like a Speedometer and Stressometer in one
Look at it while wearing Engineer's Goggles to read both. It has no stress cost
dndesires_ponder.ponder.golden_mixer.tex: The Golden Mixer is a faster Mechanical Mixer. Place it two blocks above a Basin
It has a cogwheel built in, so it's driven by cogs beside it rather than a shaft
It mixes 2.5 times faster at the same RPM, but costs 8 SU per RPM instead of 4
dndesires_ponder.ponder.spud_sentry.head: Using the Spud Sentry
dndesires_ponder.ponder.spud_sentry.text: The Spud Sentry is an automatic Potato Cannon turret, driven by cogs beside it
Feed it Potato Cannon ammo and it fires at targets in range
Choose its target priority: closest, farthest, least health, most health or random
dndesires_ponder.ponder.creative_gear_mo: The Creative Gear Motor is a creative-only power source for testing builds
It runs at 256 RPM with practically unlimited stress capacity
